title: Integrative transcriptomic analysis identifies shared EndMT-related gene signatures in endometriosis and recurrent miscarriage.
authors: Liang, Yue; Yu, Liangcheng; Zhou, Qingde; Su, Danjie; Wang, Lu; Li, Cong; Wang, Jingjing; Wang, Haihui; Dong, Jie; Xiao, Xifeng; Wang, Xiaohong
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过转录组生物信息学分析子宫内膜异位症与复发性流产共享的EndMT相关基因，虽涉及转录因子调控网络，但核心是表达谱与免疫浸润，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Endometriosis (EMs) and recurrent miscarriage (RM) represent major reproductive health challenges. This study investigates the involvement of endothelial-mesenchymal transition (EndMT) in these conditions through integrative bioinformatics analysis, focusing on the dysregulation of EndMT-related genes (EndMTRGs). Transcriptomic datasets of EMs and RM were retrieved from the gene expression omnibus (GEO) database. Specifically, GSE120103 includes 18 endometriosis and 18 control samples, and GSE165004 includes 24 recurrent miscarriage and 24 control samples. Differentially expressed gene (DEG) analysis and EndMTRG profiling were performed to identify key pathways and hub genes associated with EndMT. Functional enrichment analyses, including gene ontology (GO), Kyoto encyclopedia of genes and genomes (KEGG), and gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA), were conducted. A protein-protein interaction (PPI) network was constructed via the STRING database, and hub genes were identified using cytoHubba algorithms. Immune cell infiltration patterns were evaluated through single-sample GSEA (ssGSEA). Additionally, support vector machine recursive feature elimination (SVM-RFE) was applied as a supplementary method to assist key gene selection, and nomograms were developed for preliminary risk prediction modeling. A total of 13 EndMTRGs were identified, with key genes such as FGF2, ITGB1, VIM, NR4A1, MAPK1, SMAD1, TUBB3, and CDH11 validated across external datasets. ROC curve analysis demonstrated high diagnostic performance of these genes. Regulatory networks involving RNA-binding proteins and transcription factors were delineated. Immune cell-related gene set enrichment analysis (ssGSEA) revealed distinct immune signatures, notably involving gamma-delta T (gammadelta T) cells and monocytes in EMs, and T follicular helper (Tfh) cells and natural killer (NK) cells in RM. Nomograms based on key genes exhibited reasonable predictive performance. This study elucidates the dysregulated EndMT landscape shared by endometriosis and recurrent miscarriage, identifying common gene signatures and immune features. These findings provide molecular insights into the shared pathogenesis of these conditions and highlight potential targets for future translational research.
abstract_zh: 子宫内膜异位症（EMs）和复发性流产（RM）是重大的生殖健康挑战。本研究通过整合生物信息学分析，探讨内皮-间质转化（EndMT）在这些疾病中的作用，重点关注EndMT相关基因（EndMTRGs）的失调。从基因表达综合（GEO）数据库中获取了EMs和RM的转录组数据集。具体而言，GSE120103包含18个子宫内膜异位症样本和18个对照样本，GSE165004包含24个复发性流产样本和24个对照样本。进行了差异表达基因（DEG）分析和EndMTRG谱分析，以识别与EndMT相关的关键通路和核心基因。进行了功能富集分析，包括基因本体论（GO）、京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）和基因集富集分析（GSEA）。通过STRING数据库构建了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络，并使用cytoHubba算法识别核心基因。通过单样本GSEA（ssGSEA）评估了免疫细胞浸润模式。此外，应用支持向量机递归特征消除（SVM-RFE）作为辅助方法以帮助关键基因选择，并开发了列线图用于初步风险预测建模。共鉴定出13个EndMTRGs，其中关键基因如FGF2、ITGB1、VIM、NR4A1、MAPK1、SMAD1、TUBB3和CDH11在外部数据集中得到验证。ROC曲线分析显示这些基因具有较高的诊断性能。描绘了涉及RNA结合蛋白和转录因子的调控网络。免疫细胞相关基因集富集分析（ssGSEA）揭示了独特的免疫特征，特别涉及EMs中的γδT（gammadelta T）细胞和单核细胞，以及RM中的滤泡辅助T（Tfh）细胞和自然杀伤（NK）细胞。基于关键基因的列线图表现出合理的预测性能。本研究阐明了子宫内膜异位症和复发性流产共有的EndMT失调景观，识别了共同的基因特征和免疫特征。这些发现为这些疾病的共同发病机制提供了分子见解，并突出了未来转化研究的潜在靶点。
